limits: Getter calls and successful drain results in the baseline are actual isolated helper observations, not evidence that a real payer store or native transport was released.
The corrected current runtime helper, short real watchdog/backoff timers and unchanged 16-case regression were executed. SDK/SQLite/x402/native application owners were not imported.
A resolved true result is historical component evidence only. Later drift cannot undo it or establish a fresh physical resource, custody, funding, retry or signing permit.
The caller still owns HOLD, quarantine and retry decisions. A separate later healthy helper invocation cannot rewrite an earlier false result or clear an owner latch.
Captured-intrinsic checks do not authenticate a realm already changed before module loading, prevent hostile same-process changes between observations, hard-cancel a probe or supply an OS deadline.
The old helper result and source-bound native manifests remain unchanged at their original snapshots. Current native applications require their own new exact-source qualification.
